Sanskrit-first: bīja-vowels held letter-exact (a i u / ā ī ū / e oṃ / ai au / e ai o au / am / aḥ); ra/la, varga-names (ka ca ṭa ta pa), and Śrīkālikā kept as terms. Rows: 2 (compound-lists kept whole), 6 (gait of refutation: na … api … ca), 9 (end-weight doctrine words line-final), 1 (colon-lands before catalogs). Close: verdicts line-final. Read aloud: cadence-checked — each seed and count lands on stress. Varga-roll (ka ca ṭa ta pa): class-names in order, fivefold close.

lines: There from the unsurpassable: the ka-class
of faith; the ca-class of object-bearing will;
the pair ṭa- and ta-classes from awakening;
the pa-class from union with the five powers —
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra anuttarāt kavargaḥ śraddhāyāḥ icchāyāḥ cavargaḥ sakarmikāyā icchāyā dvau ṭavargas tavargaś ca unmeṣāt pavargaḥ śaktipañcakayogāt pañcakatvam

reads_against.argmap: How do the consonant-classes distribute over the śaktis? → Varga-distribution maps consonant-classes onto the śakti-structure: faith, object-will, awakening, fivefold-union.
c1_essence: Consonant-classes distribute over the powers: ka of faith, ca of object-will, double ṭa/ta of awakening, pa of fivefold union.
